messages:
Sam: Morning all — quick async standup. audits / KMS rotation dry-run / vuln PR / CR pings. I'll list items below.

Sam: What I did: ran last-night audit sweep, triaged CVE-2025-1234 findings in staging, applied patch to service-auth but holding on canary until we confirm key rotation.

Mira: Blocker: staging KMS rotation dry-run fails with AccessDenied when re-encrypting system keys. Getting `AccessDenied` on re-encrypt call.

Jun: Seen it too. Looks like the staging service role lacks `kms:ReEncrypt*` in the policy — failing when re-wrapping keys.

Sam: Can someone try adding `kms:ReEncrypt*` to `role/redwood-service-staging` and re-run dry-run? If it fixes, I'll schedule rotation for later today.

Ava: On it. Will test in dev cluster and report back in ~30m :coffee:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: key rotation dry-run queued for staging at 2026-03-17T10:30Z — job #4821

Ava: Dev test complete. Policy change needed on staging role: added `kms:ReEncrypt*`. Re-encrypt step now succeeds, no AccessDenied.

Mira: Blocker cleared for me — re-running audit packages and will pick up remaining CVE items.

Jun: PR 4321 (vuln patch) is ready for review — cc @Sam @Mira — small change in token validation logic.

Sam: Looking now. If review passes we can roll to canary today. Also FYI two other small CRs: CR 4330 (logging fix) and CR 4332 (metrics). Mira, can you prioritize 4330 after the audit?

Mira: Yes — will push a quick fix for the log formatting and leave a short PR note.

Ava: Rotation dry-run result pasted: 
```json
{"job":"key-rotation-dryrun","status":"success","reencrypted":3}
```

Jun: Nice. One ask on audit exports — can we include `aws_account` in the findings CSV? would speed triage.

Sam: Agree, that would help. Mira — can you add account column to the audit export job in the next run?

Mira: Yep, I can add `aws_account` to the CSV and schedule the next export.

Sam: Plan for today: finish review for PR 4321, merge and start canary if green; finalize KMS rotation schedule and run final audit; follow up on remaining CVEs. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:

Ava: Copy that — will report back if anything else pops up.

Sam: Thanks team.
